# Spoken Malayalam level plan

Counts are teaching entries (words, inflections, and phrases), not unique word families or proficiency scores.

| Tier | Levels | Entries | Cumulative entries |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| Novice | 7 | 166 | 166 |
| Elementary | 11 | 272 | 438 |
| Intermediate | 10 | 242 | 680 |
| Advanced | 7 | 181 | 861 |
| Mastery | 5 | 135 | 996 |

The [complete vocabulary inventory](curriculum_inventory.tsv) lists the words and phrases in every level.

| Level | Topic | Entries | Learning goal |
| --- | --- | ---: | --- |
| Novice Level 1 | Kinship & Addressing People | 25 | Immediate and extended family titles (achayan, chechi, ammachi, ammayi, aliya), personal pronouns (njan, nee, njangal, avar), respectful vs. peer addressing. |
| Novice Level 2 | Greetings, Introductions & Repair | 20 | Introduce yourself, greet a visitor, and ask for repetition when you do not understand. |
| Novice Level 3 | Numbers, Prices & Quantities | 24 | Count small quantities, understand common prices, and ask how much you need to pay. |
| Novice Level 4 | Kitchen Essentials & Food Preferences | 25 | Staple foods (choru, vellam, chaaya, meen, erachi), simple yes/no/quantity limits (venda, mathi, kurachu, theere venda, kooduthal). |
| Novice Level 5 | The 15 Survival Verbs | 25 | Core actions in simple imperative & present forms (vaa, po, kazhikku, kudi, iri, para, kelkku, thaa, edu, cheyyu). |
| Novice Level 6 | People, Things & Simple Descriptions | 22 | Describe an object and combine familiar nouns with size, colour, and possession. |
| Novice Level 7 | Fast Reactions & Conversational Fillers | 25 | Emotional cues and fillers (ayyo, saramilla, sathyam, aano, sherikkum, pinne, athre ullu, enthaa). |
| Elementary Level 1 | Conversational Questions & Direction | 25 | Question words and directional anchors (evideya, eppozha, entha, aara, engane, ivide, avide, nere, appurathe). |
| Elementary Level 2 | Calendar, Time & Appointments | 24 | Arrange a meeting, understand dates, and describe when something happens. |
| Elementary Level 3 | Buses, Autos & Travel | 24 | Buy a ticket, check a destination, and tell a driver where to stop. |
| Elementary Level 4 | Groceries, Money & Ordering | 28 | Ask for ingredients, order a meal, pay, and explain a simple dietary preference. |
| Elementary Level 5 | Spoken Past Tense & Everyday Routines | 30 | Everyday past-tense markers (kazhicho, poyi, vannu, urangiyo, kandu, cheythu) and time words (innale, innum, nerathe, vaiki). |
| Elementary Level 6 | Future Intentions & Casual Commitments | 25 | The -aam and -um spoken future forms (varaam, kazhikkaam, nokkam, cheyyaam, naale, matte-naal). |
| Elementary Level 7 | Describing Physical States & Desires | 25 | Needs and physical feelings (vishakkunnu, thadasam, choodu, thanippu, urakkam varunnu, sheenam, vayya). |
| Elementary Level 8 | Body, Health & Asking for Help | 24 | Name common symptoms and ask someone for help or a medical appointment. |
| Elementary Level 9 | Home, Chores & Daily Objects | 25 | Objects around the room (vaathil, janala, kaasu, phone, chaavi, vandi, bhaagyam). |
| Elementary Level 10 | Clothes, Washing & Getting Ready | 18 | Choose clothes, explain sizes, and talk through getting ready to go out. |
| Elementary Level 11 | Weather, Outdoors & Places | 24 | Describe the weather and surroundings, and suggest a simple outing. |
| Intermediate Level 1 | Conjunctions & Sentence Connectors | 25 | Glue words that create flowing speech (ennittum, athukondu, pakshe, athinaale, allenkil, ennaalum). |
| Intermediate Level 2 | Telling a Story & Sequencing Events | 22 | Retell an experience using sequence, cause, reported speech, and a conclusion. |
| Intermediate Level 3 | Conditional Statements ('If / When') | 25 | Spoken -aal and -appol forms (vannal, paranjaal, kandappol, poyappol, cheythaal nannayi). |
| Intermediate Level 4 | Work, Tasks & Phone Calls | 22 | Describe work, ask for clarification, and arrange a call or task handover. |
| Intermediate Level 5 | School, Learning & Technology | 24 | Explain a learning problem and ask for help with a document or device. |
| Intermediate Level 6 | Hobbies, Media & Preferences | 22 | Discuss something you watched, compare preferences, and recommend an activity. |
| Intermediate Level 7 | Opinions, Doubts & Comparisons | 25 | Expressing perspective (thoonnunnu, vishwasamilla, athekkāl nallathu, enthekilum, chilappol, oru karyam parayatte). |
| Intermediate Level 8 | Errands, Shopping & Outside Interactions | 25 | Interacting at shops, restaurants, and appointments (vilakooduthal, kurakkumo, baakki, chodyam, ready aayo). |
| Intermediate Level 9 | Relationships, Invitations & Boundaries | 22 | Invite someone, decline with a reason, and express a boundary respectfully. |
| Intermediate Level 10 | Teasing, Sarcasm & Informal Banter | 30 | Playful reactions, idioms, and attitude (thallu, scene aanu, veruthe, sceneilla, kollam, pinnallathe, shook, jaada). |
| Advanced Level 1 | Nuance Tags & Suffix Flow | 25 | Micro-modifiers that define tone (-allo for affirmation, -tto for friendly warning/promise, -ketto, -enne, -thanne). |
| Advanced Level 2 | Complex Emotional States & Dispositions | 30 | Subtle internal feelings (deshyam, sankadam, maduppu, kothiyaavunnu, ashwasam, vedhana, pedi, bharam). |
| Advanced Level 3 | Compound Verbs & Natural Contractions | 30 | Natural contractions (kondubovaam, ittaekku, paranjukodukku, nokkikkollu, aayi-theernnu). |
| Advanced Level 4 | Problems, Explanations & Negotiation | 22 | Explain a problem, compare possible solutions, and agree on a next step. |
| Advanced Level 5 | News, Society & Evaluating Claims | 24 | Summarise a news item, distinguish opinion from evidence, and explain uncertainty. |
| Advanced Level 6 | Family Lore, Tradition & Festive Vocabulary | 25 | Wedding, feast, religious, and holiday registers (sadya, kalyanam, perunnal, acharam, anugraham, bandhangal). |
| Advanced Level 7 | Expressing Disagreement & Tactful Pushback | 25 | Polite and informal debate (athalla njan paranjathu, anganeyonnum alla, athil karyamilla, sammathikkilla). |
| Mastery Level 1 | Rapid Colloquial Slang & Generational Idioms | 30 | Contemporary youth slang, inside jokes, and culturally loaded slang phrases (adipoli, kidu, vibe, scene kando, uyir, mass). |
| Mastery Level 2 | Classic Proverbs & Everyday Metaphors | 25 | Frequently referenced sayings and metaphors (minnunnathellaam ponnalla, kaaryam kaanaan kalipidikkuka, mulla poovinu manamilla). |
| Mastery Level 3 | Subtext, Irony & Passive Phrasing | 25 | Knowing how to say things without stating them directly; reading between the lines in family dynamics. |
| Mastery Level 4 | Deep Vocabulary & Abstract Conversation | 30 | Discussing philosophy, personal ethics, politics, and abstract career topics naturally. |
| Mastery Level 5 | Dialect & Accent Switching | 25 | Recognizing differences between Central (Kottayam/Kochi/Adoor), Northern (Malabar), and Southern (Trivandrum) vocabulary nuances. |
